source: Traced from William's 26_06_30 Schematic Plans, sheet 3 'ROOF PLAN - PROPOSED' (1/4" = 1'-0", vector PDF), registered to house.json by fitting the 6/30 floor plan and the roof plan's dashed wall lines to the existing walls (17.98 pt/ft, median fit error about 1.5 in). Pitch and eave heights come from the 26_07_24 rough structural section and live in HEIGHTS in index.html.
note: Hand-traced, not exported. If the roof plan changes, re-trace or (better) add the roof to scripts/export_3d.py in the floor-plan project. Feet, same axes as house.json.

hips.name: Main block
hips.note: hip roof, ridge N-S at x 45.2 from y 32.55 to 65.79; covers dining, carport, east bedrooms

hips.name: Living wing
hips.note: hip end to the west, ridge at y 67.93; east end is buried in the main block (traced ridge stops at x 43.05)

hips.name: Master wing
hips.note: hip end to the west, ridge at y 26.85 from x 37.51 to the main hip at 39.55; east end buried in the main block

flats.name: Lanai
flats.note: low-slope area (keynote 09: min 1/4 in per ft, tapered insulation) Exposed underneath over the lanai (William's photos): white decking at the ceiling height on 4x6 joists ~33-1/4 in o.c. (LANAI_JOISTS in index.html).

flats.name: Studio
flats.note: low-slope area; the hip lines drawn on it are tapered-insulation crickets to a high point at (30.0, 19.34)

not_traced: 6/30 flat trellis/canopy east of the carport and porch (x 60.27-73.84, y 44.76-80.8, keynotes 41/42): it overlaps the H10e wing, so it is left out until William confirms whether it stays

addition.note: H10e east wing: not in the 6/30 roof plan. Hip option per William's sketch (2026-10-30): wing hip (rect) + an east-west cross ridge (cross.rect). Flat option for comparison.

cross.note: William's sketch 2026-10-30: the front (east) hip stays a clean trapezoid; a perpendicular ridge at about y 32 runs west from the wing's ridge and dies into the main roof's east slope, so no valley runs parallel to the main ridge. Drawn as a hip block with an east-west ridge at the wing's ridge height (half-width = the wing's), its west end buried in the main roof; its east end is coplanar with the wing's front hip. Ridge position scaled from the sketch.

leantos.name: Front porch
leantos.note: William 2026-10-30: the porch roof is essentially a lean-to with a slightly shallower slope than the main roof. Drawn from the house wall (hidden under the main roof) out to the traced porch eave at x 62.6; it meets the main eave line (x 60.27) 2.33 ft in. Pitch in CLAD.porchPitch (assumed 1-3/4 in 12).
